segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ito po ay mag-a-address dun sa mga informal settler families na mababa ang sahod

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Now, as we await other colleagues, the Chair would like to ask some questions.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: First, regarding expanded 4PH as presented and mentioned by the Secretary

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: in the presentation, is this still the government's flagship housing program?

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Yes, it is still the flagship program for the housing.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Yes, according to data, expanded 4PH program targets a delivery of 301,040 units by June 2028.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: However, as of June 2026, only 41.7% of this target has reportedly been delivered,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: with only two years remaining before the target date.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: How confident is DHSUD that it can deliver the remaining 175,000 or so housing units?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Or what's the new target? Have we adjusted our target?

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Number one, Mr. Chairman, the target is still the same.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Now, we are confident that we will hit that, we will be able to comply with that commitment.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: As the numbers will show, yung jump natin from the first three years,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: then when we expanded the 4PH by adding modalities,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Now, based on that momentum, we are confident that we will still hit the 300,000.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Okay, I'm hoping also because this will be the acid test for the department.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Of course, for this, supposedly the landmark legislation, we are hoping that it will really perform.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ito rin yung question, kasi nakita ko kanina yung I was asking my staff also.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, if you would look at the budget of...

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: They should, lalo yung attached agencies.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, it's quite low compared to other major departments.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, sabi ko, syempre, being the author of this, I would want...

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: They should to have bigger budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: But ang problema, with the low obligation and disbursement rate of the program,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: the question is, why should Congress provide another 1 billion or so in subsidy for 2027

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: while significant prior year subsidy remains?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And what specific bottlenecks have been removed?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, yun ang ano natin because of the low fiscal space as well.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Syempre, alam mo naman dito, pag yung unutilized, yung hindi...

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Merong funds that have not been disbursed, especially to the end of the year.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Talagang kukunin, ano yan, ilalagay sa iba.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, Sek, ano bang ano natin dito?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: How can we improve yung ating obligation disbursement rate?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So that, at least, if we ask for additional...

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Actually, yung request niya about 2 billion sana, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sabi ko, kung pwede natin bigay, I will, to increase the production.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: What specific bottlenecks and prior year subsidy that remains unused, paano natin ito may utilize?

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: For the unutilized, Mr. Chairman, for the unutilized subsidy budget,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: ang naging problema kasi dito during the first three years,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: hindi natin na-issue yung IRR for the Horizontal Socialized Housing.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So, nung na-issue po natin ito noong 2025,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: nakita na doon po lang nagsimula, gumawa ang karamihan sa mga private sector developers na socialized housing for...

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, there was a considerable delay.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: There was a delay in the...

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Sa pagsimula, waiting for the IRR.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Hindi nila alam magkano yung price ceiling ng, say, 26 square meters, 27, no?

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Then, if you will note also...

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So, for PH kasi, among the modalities, dalawang modalities lang dyan ang nagkakaroon ng interest subsidy.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: These are the vertical and horizontal modalities.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So, as I said, ngayon pa lang talaga nagsisimulang matapos yung mga horizontal developments

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: dahil nag-antay po sila ng IRR sa kabagong price ceiling na ilabas natin noong December 23, 2025.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So, we expect na this year and towards the end of this year,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: this year and 2027 po, dadami yung take-out natin ng horizontal housing units na magkakaroon po sila, magkaka-avail po sila noong subsidy.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, by this time, Sek, siguro yung mga na-delay na projects on will be already ready for occupancy and for disposal and for take-out.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: What are the measurable 2027 targets for modality?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: As you mentioned, vertical, horizontal, enhanced EMP, rental, temporary housing.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ang tinitingnan po natin na mataas talaga yung numero is the Community Mortgage Program

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: and the High-Density Housing Program of SHFC.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ito po yung inihinga natin ng dagdag na budget sana.

segments.text: Requested for about 2 billion for CNP.

segments.speaker: NHA General Manager Joeben A. Tai

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, hopefully we can implement it as DepEd.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At ito naman yung sa in-city and near-city housing, actually.

segments.text: What is DSHOD's policy for prioritizing in-city, near-site, and near-city housing before families are relocated farther away?

segments.text: So, ito rin pa yung ano natin?

segments.text: Mr. Chairman, this is the challenge of socialized housing.

segments.text: Which we are now doing in some LGUs.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito

segments.text: And then we are also discussing with other LGUs na sa NCR.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Okay, thank you. At this point, Senator Bongo, I would like to make a manifestation and probably ask some questions.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Salamat, Mr. Chairman, Senator J.B. Hercito. At siya po yung principal sponsor nitong inyong departamento noong 17th Congress.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Dahil po yan sa kanya at napirmahan rin po ni former President Duterte na meron ng sariling departamento para sa housing.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: I would like to manifest my support.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: For the budget of the Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Salamat po sa inyong servisyo. Headed by Secretary Jose Ramon Aliling sa lahat ng mga USECs. Narito, USEC Robles, USEC IAP.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: And of course, itong touch agencies ninyo, ang NHA, headed by GM Joe Bentay, sa Pag-ibig, Social Housing Finance Corporation, National House of...

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: National Home Mortgage Finance Corporation, Human Settlements Education Commission.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sa inyong lahat, Commissioner IAP, Commissioner Tolentino, CEO Marlene Acosta.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Klamihan po sa inyo yung nakatrabaho ko na rin po lahat noon.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: PCEO Federico Laxa ng Social Housing. Salamat sa inyong servisyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sa isahin ko na lang po lahat.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Toto Tobias, Amado Ablao, Director Benji Lett, Suniga, Director Vizpo.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Salamat sa inyo, sa lahat po na empleyado ng Dishud.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Full support po ako sa inyo always.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ang ehensyang ito ay mahalagang tungkulin at yakin na ang bawat pamilyang Pilipino ay may disenting tirahan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At yung pinangarap natin na sana na walang...

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Walang dapat na squatter sa sarili nating bayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Kaya bawat pisong inilaan natin para sa pabahay ay dapat direktang mapakinabangan ng mga pamilyang higit na nangangailangan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Lalong-lalo na po yung mga mahirap nating kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: The proposed 2027 NEP allocates a total budget of 5.499 billion for the Dishud.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: This is 9.5 lower than the 2026 total program budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: While the proposed budget is reduced, the need for decent and affordable housing has not diminished.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: In fact, with the rising cost of land and construction materials at sa taas po ng presyo ng bilihin,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: lalong nagiging mahirap para sa ordinaryong Pilipino na magkaroon ng sariling tahanan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sa kakaikot ko po sa buong bansa, nakikita kong kalagayan ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sunog, baha, lindol, putok ng bulkan, mga sakuna. Maraming sa ating mga kababayan po ang nangangailangan ng tulong sa pabahay.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sana po ay mas paigtingin pa ng Dishud ang kanilang mga programang magbibigay tulong sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Lalo na yung mga walang matakbuhan kundi po ang gobyerno.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Meron lang po akong katanungan about the housing backlog.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Mr. Chair, the magnitude of our country's housing problem remains a serious concern.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: For years, government estimates placed a...

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: the country's housing need at around 6.5 million units.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: With the earlier projections warning that housing requirements could reach as high as 22 million units by 2040

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Kung hindi po ito ma-address, it could reach as high as 22 million units

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Dishud has recently stated that the actual...

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: the housing backlog is approximately 2.2 million units.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sino pong sasagot nito? Dishud, no? Sekretary Aliling.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Mr. Chair, based on the latest PSA study,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: ang forecast natin sa housing need by 2028 is 3.7 million units.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ito po yung may mga sariling tahanan, unit kailangan i-rehabilitate or ayusin.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So most likely, nandyan po sa 1.1 million na yan, yung mga informal settler families.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ang solution po na nakikita natin dyan under the 4PH is the community mortgage program.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Para pag na-award po sa kanila yung kanilang mga tinitirhan,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: mas mainganyo silang magpaayos, magpa-repair ng mga tahanan nila.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Then the second is the 2.2 million na tinatawag natin double up.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Ito pong double up, ito po yung may multiple families living under one roof.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So ito po, buong span po ito, hindi lang ito socialized housing, pati open market kasama rito.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So kahit na may kaya yung pamilya, basta more than one family ang nakatira, kasama po sila dito sa 2.2.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Then the 400,000 remaining of the 3.7 million is yung forecast nung neto,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So yung po yung 3.7 million, ang gusto lang po natin yung highlight dito,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: na yung 4PH po, pag na-expand natin ito, napalago natin, naparami natin yung output nito,

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: should ultimately help resolve the projected housing need of 3.7 million by 2028.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Salamat. Pwede natin pasingitin muna natin ang Mr. Trabajador ng Senado.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Trabajador dito, lagari rin po kami, konektado po itong housing. Lagari yung trabaho.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I'd like to ask our Majority Leader for his questions, Ms. Consul.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Chairman, pleasant good afternoon, Secretary, to the members of the housing agencies.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Salamat, Senator Bong, kasi lagari ako, I have to go back as Majority Floor Leader in the floor.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: There's still discussions being taken up on the bills on the floor.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Nag-file rin po ako, actually pumasa kanina sa sponsorship pa lang po ng aping chairman sa Committee on Housing na si Senator Cheese.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Itong Senate Bill 415, ito po yung rental housing subsidy. Ito po yung which seeks to provide rental assistance to informal settlers and families displaced by disasters as a way to help them transition into the formal housing market na sponsor na po ito kanina.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Para sa maraming pamilya, lalong-lalo na po sa mga informal settlers na nawala ng tahanan dahil sa kalamidad, mayroon silang agarang tulong kagad isang mas ligtas at disenting lugar na matitirahan habang unti-unti silang nakakabangon at makabalik sa kanilang mga pamamahay.

segments.text: Tutulungan sila ng gobyerno o kalahating amount sa renta hanggang makabalik sila sa kanilang tirahan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Pero ito yung sa mga tinatamaan ng disasters. Pero itong problema natin sa housing sa ngayon, kailan po kaya mangyayari yung panaginip o pangarap natin na sana naman wala ng squatter sa sariling bayan?

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Dahil napansin ko napakaliit po talaga ng budget ng dishwood. Kumbaga sa cake, icing lang siguro wala po.

segments.text: Kaya nga po yung expanded 4PH natin.

segments.text: Hindi nagdag natin dyan yung community mortgage program sa parental housing. Ito po eh para sa ating mga kababayan na eventually magkakaroon ng bahay pero hindi pa nila kaya. segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Private sector developers. Tinignan po natin yung strength ng government sa private sector. segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: In fact, 3% lang po ang interest rate ngayon ng pag-ibig.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: Sa socialized housing, pag bumili ang ating mga miyembro ng pag-ibig dito. So less than half po ito ng regular na interest na binibigay ng regular banks.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So makikita po natin itong 2025-2026, ang mag-apply na po ng license to sell in terms of number of units sa socialized housing, nasa 35,000 per year na po.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So before we introduce this pag-ibig 3%, ang application lang po natin ng 2022-2024 was around 13,000 to 15,000 units. So more than double po ang socialized housing natin na application.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So ang sinasabi lang po natin dito, pag napalawak natin yung scope o yung masasakukan ng community mortgage program, na wala po tayong ibang pagkukuna niya kung hindi through GA.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: And ma-encourage pa natin yung mga socialized housing developers.

segments.speaker: DHSUD Secretary Jose Ramon P. Aliling
segments.text: So, by addressing the demand side, maliit talaga yung budget. Maliit po yung, kasi I think [unclear] lang yung nakalagay
